snippet.title: Juiced Fruit Racing Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
Splash and smash your friends in this juicy party kart racing game! Make and take speedy shortcuts as you compete against the sweetest competition. A wholesome and hectic racer packed with power-ups and heavy laughter.

Coming October 24 to Steam and consoles!
